scope: One real first-layer Q projection excerpt (128x5376), token-type-disjoint inputs. Not whole-model generation or Pi proof.
calibration_texts: A small library stores books by subject and author. Readers compare a story with a newspaper article, write a summary, and explain the difference. The teacher asks why the character changed her mind after the storm. A programmer sorts numbers, checks empty input, and returns a dictionary. The database keeps an index for names and uses a transaction to update balances. An engineer measures voltage, resistance, current, temperature, speed and time. The garden has red flowers, green leaves, wet soil and two tall trees. Write a careful answer in English, show the calculation, and check every unit. Explain how a function handles missing values, duplicate keys, and invalid types. A train leaves the station at noon and arrives before sunset. Compare multiplication and division using fractions and whole numbers. The scientist records each observation and repeats the experiment.

Volcanic ash alters atmospheric chemistry while ocean currents redistribute thermal energy between continents. Geologists examine sedimentary layers and measure isotope ratios to estimate the age of mineral deposits. A compiler transforms expressions into instructions; concurrent threads require synchronization when modifying shared resources. Describe photosynthesis, cellular respiration, evaporation, condensation and gravitational acceleration. A violinist adjusts pitch while an orchestra rehearses. A municipality repairs bridges and schedules waste collection during winter. The detective interviews witnesses and distinguishes evidence from speculation. A graph algorithm visits vertices and records predecessor relationships. Recursive descent parsers recognize nested parentheses and operator precedence.

Archaeologists catalog ceramic fragments discovered beneath a medieval courtyard. Migratory birds navigate coastlines, wetlands, mountains and seasonal weather. Astronomers estimate stellar luminosity using spectroscopic measurements. The bakery kneads dough, regulates fermentation, and monitors oven humidity. Cryptographic authentication prevents undetected modification of transmitted messages. A distributed queue retries interrupted jobs and deduplicates acknowledgements. Explain the relationship between biodiversity, pollination, agriculture and habitat. Analyze a sonnet's imagery, rhythm, metaphors and narrative perspective. Numerical integration approximates the area beneath a continuous curve. An electric motor converts electromagnetic forces into rotational motion.
